verdict.rationale: Benchmark's own API documents programmatic access to audiences (searching contacts and managing lists) and to campaign results that can be pulled into dashboards or digests. Nothing in the evidence shows API access to live automations: API key permissions cover only contacts, campaigns, reports and domains. No OpenAPI spec was found for agents to consume. missing for 10: programmatic read access to live automations/workflows, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), detail on which report metrics are exposed, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Search contacts by email, custom field, list, status, or creation date.
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
